gloss: to endure; to conceal oneself; to reminisce

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {忍|しの}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to endure; to bear; to put up with
definitions.explanation: To patiently withstand hardship, pain, or difficult circumstances without complaining.

definitions.gloss: to conceal oneself; to hide; to do something secretly
definitions.explanation: To act stealthily or keep something hidden from others. The root meaning behind the word ninja (忍者).
To fondly recall or yearn for the past, a person, or a place. Often literary.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat formal verb with three distinct senses. Sense 1 (endurance) is the most common in modern usage. Sense 2 (concealment) is the etymological root of ⟦{忍者|にんじゃ}→忍者：11112_ninja⟧ and ⟦{忍|しの}び→忍び：12606_shinobi⟧. Sense 3 (reminiscence) is mostly literary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忍|しの}ぶ (to hold back tears)
- ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忍|しの}ぶ (to avoid being seen)
- ⟦{忍|しの}び{足|あし}→忍び足：16016_shinobiashi⟧ (stealthy steps, tiptoeing)
- {耐|た}え{忍|しの}ぶ (to endure, to persevere)
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忍|しの}ぶ (to reminisce about the past)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure — more neutral and widely used
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}する→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧: to put up with — everyday, less literary
